# A0: Storytelling First
As a community, we have allowances to tell a story, as sometimes a story will include elements that go against the rules. In these instances, if all players are consenting to the scene, there will be no need for admin intervention.
- You must have the OOC permission of everyone in the scene before conducting the rulebreak listed below: -- B1.3 where your killer grants permission to remember them, B1.4, B2’s roleplaying requirements, B3, C1, C2. - Without permission and agreements of all players involved, A0 is not applicable and players would be punished appropriately.
## Examples: 1). You and your friend are playing characters that despise each other. You have agreed beforehand OOCly that you are ‘on sight'. During the shift, you spot one another and immediately escalate to using force. [bold]Although a breach of Rule B1.4, there is no need for admin intervention[/bold].
2). You have been given OOC permission to join a round and join your friend's ship whilst they are SSD. You pilot it, use it, and perform actions all within your friend's permission. [bold]Whilst a breach of rule B3, this is permitted[/bold].
